description: Recommends accessible GSAP, Motion, WAAPI, Three.js/R3F, or conditional Lenis animation recipes with reduced-motion and cleanup guarantees.

category.description: Restrict recipes to one motion category; omit or `all` for every category.

motion_intensity.description: Motion dial 0-10 (default 6); 0 means motion off and returns no recipes.

recipe.description: Return exactly one recipe by id (e.g. `hero-gsap-masked-split`), regardless of intensity.

name: recommend_animation
